claims.text: Moratorium on data-center applications, last five years: on December 9, 2025 the city adopted a six-month moratorium on accepting any applications for new data centers (RES2025-094); RES2026-043, adopted May 12, 2026, extended it to September 9, 2026. It covered data centers, not warehouse or other industrial uses.
claims.quote: WHEREAS, on December 9, 2025, the City of South Fulton instituted a six-month MORATORIUM ON THE ACCEPTANCE OF ANY APPLICATIONS RELATED TO THE NEW DEVELOPMENT OR ESTABLSHIMENT OF ANY DATA CENTER OR OTHER LARGGE SCALE DATA STORAGE which was designated as RES2025-094;

claims.text: The same resolution extends the moratorium to September 9, 2026 (its text gives the original date as 12/09/2026, apparently a typo for 2025).
claims.quote: Section 1. That the Data Center Moratorium which was passed by the Mayor and Council of the City of South Fulton on 12/09/2026, which is designated as RES2025-094, and including all provisions of Resolution RES2025-094, be extended until September 9, 2026.

claims.text: New data-center rules pending or adopted: the draft replacement ordinance would bar any data center within 2,640 ft of property zoned or used for residential or mixed-use purposes. The lead parcel adjoins single-family subdivisions (next claim), so if this setback was adopted and applies to this project, the owner's planned data center here could not meet it. Adoption, final wording and any vesting of the 2024-25 project were not confirmed.
claims.quote: B. Minimum Setback: No data center shall be located within 2640 feet of any property zoned or used for mixed-use or residential purposes, measured from property line to property line.
